read.thesis: Software-led IBM grew revenue 6% and FCF 13% to $2.2B in Q1 with software guided to 10%+ and Confluent lifting data; hardware supply discipline is not discussed, so the read is mostly demand and margin, not capacity.

capex.quote: increased investments in CapEx as we expected coming into 2026

triggers.label: IBM Z growth 48% in Q1
triggers.quote: IBM Z continues to outperform prior programs, growing 48% this quarter.

triggers.label: Software guide raised to 10%+
triggers.quote: Our revenue expectations are underpinned by our accelerating software business, which we now expect to grow 10-plus percent this year.

triggers.label: Full-year guide only reaffirmed; infra down LSD
triggers.quote: we prudently continue to expect infrastructure revenue to be down low single digits for the year

guidance.quote: we remain confident in our ability to sustain revenue growth of 5% plus
grow free cash flow by about $1 billion this year
which we now expect to grow 10-plus percent this year
We now see data up low 20-plus percent range.
stay on track to expand operating pretax margins by about 1 point this year
we prudently continue to expect infrastructure revenue to be down low single digits for the year
continue to support an acceleration in revenue growth to low to mid-single digits for the year

prior_guidance_check.quote: We talked about entering the year 10% growth. Now we see it growing 10-plus percent accelerating.
we anticipated absorbing about $600 million of dilution from Confluent in 2026

red_flags.label: Q1 software growth decelerated to 8% from ~11% in Q4
Hardware supply chain and memory cost pressure
red_flags.quote: a very dislocated hardware supply chain market

evasions.topic: Why not raise FY guidance after strong Q1
evasions.quote: But again, first quarter in, we're 90 days into an extremely important year. And our view is we should be prudent.
